content.title: Co-Designing with Generative AI, Reflecting with Communities: Lessons Learned from Image-Based Participatory Design of Communal Neighbourhood Spaces in Nordic Superblocks
content.abstract: Nordic Superblocks have emerged as a concept to rethink communal neighbourhood life by creating shared spaces for versatile activities. Central to this concept is residents’ active participation in redesign, yet translating lived experiences and needs into concrete design ideas remains challenging. Generative AI (GenAI) image generation offers a promising avenue for supporting this process, but its role in participatory design (PD) of communal neighbourhood spaces remains underexplored.
